next_actions.description: Propose a minimal valid claim graph from supplied context; no repository investigation or evidence is required.
Inspect the current run residuals and state.
Record a routing commitment before investigation.
Record the first investigation witness after routing.
Record one externally observed Fold-1 research citation bound to a claim.
Request a deterministic harness spike against active research.
Re-gate a stale spike with current prerequisites.
Request a human decision for a residual claim.
Propose a ceiling change through configure_run; only renewed host approval can apply it, never auto.
Await a pending audit child; the host settles it through the trusted child_event lifecycle (Claude SubagentStop, Pi foreground tool result), not a callable wait.
Retry a failed or rejected child.
Accept the current residual and stop or continue with it recorded.
Host must refresh the observed governance context through the trusted governance_context ingress (Pi refreshGovernance, Claude _governance_context); do not retry configure_run blindly.
Correct the configure_run proposal and request a host-mediated configuration decision; cannot self-approve.
